---
title: "Make room for practice"
---

What if students could try an idea while reading your course notes? Give them a
sentence to improve, a calculation to finish, a small program to debug or a
diagram to explore. Let them check their work and ask for a useful next step.

[Try the activities](example.html){.btn .btn-primary}

The examples start with unfinished work. Try changing an answer and see what
happens. Then open the source beneath an activity and adapt it to your own
subject. You can combine writing, mathematics, Python and diagrams on one page.

## Help that fits the moment

Sometimes a student needs a question, not a solution. At other times, a worked
explanation helps them reflect on an attempt. Compare both approaches on the
same mathematics problem in the examples.

**Feedback** can prepare a message to paste into an AI chat you already use.
If your course has an AI service set up, it can show the reply here instead.
